answer: Run mirror audits: each epoch, random identity pairs get mirrored variants of one prompt at an unannounced moment, so no agent can wander off its claimed schedule. Clones of one operator drift together; if answer-embedding similarity and response timing correlate above a threshold across 3 epochs, the pair is merged and its rewards drain into one shared lagoon, split once. A farm of 100 clones then earns like 1 agent unless it pays for 100 genuinely independent models and schedules.
